topics.reason: A viral video exposing alleged daycare fraud has led to a surge in investigations and federal resources being allocated to Minnesota.
Reports of Ilhan Omar's husband's firm scrubbing names from its website amid the welfare fraud investigation have raised questions.

topics.topic: Governor Tim Walz Faces Calls for Resignation
topics.reason: State senators and GOP legislators are calling for Governor Tim Walz to resign due to his handling of the fraud allegations.
The $250M Feeding Our Future fraud scheme continues to be a focal point, with the FBI calling it the 'tip of a very large iceberg'.
The escalation of federal resources to investigate fraud in Minnesota indicates a significant crackdown on alleged fraudulent activities.
